title: Whole Mechanical Effects Preparation Workcorner
description: One static theatrical mechanical-effects preparation workcorner using four complete qualified originals and zero new independent models: a whole raised crank desk, complete pinned-cylinder open-case music box on its real full desk top, separate whole slatted-drum and cloth-apron wind machine, and complete suspended tubular-bell frame on the scene-only floor. The small bench mechanism is raised for inspection while the larger hand-cranked cloth drum and tall hanging-pipe station occupy separate floor bays beside it; there is no audience stage, piano bench, shared score or inward-facing ensemble rehearsal circle. Complete original local meshes, hierarchy, oriented triangles and full PBR are preserved without extraction, rescaling or recolouring. Only the desk undergoes one rigid ninety-degree rotation and all four instances are translated. One scene and zero new models. Static equipment arrangement only: no working sound effects, audio, operation, tuning, friction, cloth simulation, rotation, damping, ergonomics, load, stability or safety certification. No rigging, animation or interaction.
